title: Dark Glam Bathroom Upgrades
headline: Bathroom Upgrades That Look Expensive: 8 Amazon Finds, Dark Glam Edition
seo_title: Dark Glam Bathroom Upgrades: 8 Amazon Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Dark glam bathroom upgrades from Amazon: a black and gold vanity light, arched mirror, wall sconces, a black and gold marble shower curtain, luxury towels and more. Eight well-reviewed picks.
intro: The bathroom is the smallest room and the easiest place to get dramatic. Black, gold, good lighting. Done.
I built a dark glam bathroom edit from Amazon: lighting, a mirror, a shower curtain, wallpaper and the little things that finish it. Every pick is rated 4.4 stars or higher with real review counts.
Check each listing for size and fit, and for the lighting, check the install notes on the page and use a qualified electrician if needed.
I haven't tested these. I'm telling you what's well reviewed. Let's make the powder room a moment.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices, colors and availability live on Amazon and change often.

products.name: Black and Gold 3-Light Vanity Light Fixture
products.best_for: The lighting that sets the tone
copy: A black and gold vanity light for above the mirror, the single biggest upgrade in a builder-grade bath.
It rates 4.6 stars from more than 1,600 reviewers.
Verdict: swap the light and the room looks new.

products.name: Arched Wall Mirror, 30 x 40, Black
copy: A black arched vanity mirror that swaps out the plain builder mirror.

Verdict: arches look expensive in any bathroom.

products.best_for: Spa towels in the dark shades
copy: A 6-piece cotton towel set. Choose black or charcoal for the full dark glam effect.

copy: Striped peel-and-stick wallpaper for one bold bathroom wall. Check your lease first.

products.name: Black Floating Shelves, Set of 3
copy: Black floating shelves to hold the candles and rolled towels.

Verdict: vertical storage in a tiny room.

interludes.3: Rule one of the dark glam bath: light it warm.

outro: And that's the edit: eight Amazon finds for a dark glam bathroom.
If you take one thing from this guide, start with the light and the mirror. That's the whole transformation.
